comment_regular: Verified return predicate: returns true only for an NPC actor in a cell with direct XOWN, no XGLB, and neither Public nor TempPublic bit set; guards return false. With an NPC owner it returns true when the actor's base form differs; with a faction owner it returns true when actor rank is below the cell's XRNK requirement (absent XRNK defaults to rank 0). Other owner types and non-NPC actors return false. This is an ownership-restriction check; the calling script-condition identity remains Unknown.
